notes: 2026-09-10 fact pass. Address 5757 W Ajo Hwy, Tucson AZ 85735 confirmed on the church's own site; coordinates left 'approximate' because Ajo Hwy runs diagonally and was not re-geocoded. Affiliation stated on the site: Southern Baptist Convention, Arizona Southern Baptist Convention, Catalina Baptist Association. Staff page lists exactly two pastors - Lynn Spoon (Lead Pastor) and Jasper Cristales (Youth Pastor); the other two staff (Beth Mac Farlane, Ministry Assistant; Debbie Bessett, Custodian) are not preachers. Jasper Cristales is listed here as a preaching pastor because the church's own YouTube Live tab carries full-service videos titled 'Becoming | Pastor Jasper | TMBC' alongside several titled 'Pastor Lynn', so both take the pulpit. YouTube channel is @tmbctucson (title 'TMBC Tucson'); the Live tab, not the Videos tab, holds the sermons - the Videos tab is mostly worship lyric videos and VBS clips. Captions availability not yet tested.
